idle.scope: main process CPU and resident mappings; child processes excluded; mapped driver/software-GPU memory may contribute to RSS

profile_memory_after_idle.scope: Prepared image payloads referenced by current scenes only; app caches excluded. GPU buffer values are requested payloads, not driver allocations. Actual surface buffer counts and total GPU memory are unknown.

scope.startup: Service restart through wallpaper-ready IPC, including SSH/polling overhead
scope.animation: Render submission intervals, not scanout or isolated GPU execution time
scope.resources: Texture payload only; driver/framebuffer/CPU prepared-image memory excluded
scope.cache_misses: Shared application cache, including other surfaces updated during the sample
scope.service_cpu: Lucent cgroup including helpers; compositor and separately launched apps excluded
scope.cpu_profile: Successful frame submissions only; CPU-side wall-clock stages include driver waits. Preparation breakdown is nested, not additive. Instrumentation and inspection can affect the workload.
scope.resident_breakdown: Two smaps_rollup snapshots in KiB; not interval averages or separate GPU-memory measurements
